description: Decode a GLEIF Registration Authority (RA) code to the national business register's name, website and jurisdiction(s). This is the code GLEIF publishes as `registration_authority` on every LEI record (get_lei, search_lei results), naming the register that assigned the entity's `registered_as` id — "RA000585" decodes to the UK's Companies House, for example. Bare digits are zero-padded and prefixed with "RA" automatically ("585" -> "RA000585"). get_lei already decodes this field inline as registration_authority_decoded — call this tool directly only when you have a bare code from elsewhere.

code.description: GLEIF Registration Authority code, "RA" + 6 digits, e.g. "RA000585" (UK Companies House). Bare digits (e.g. "585") are accepted and normalized.

name: decode_registration_authority
title: Decode Registration Authority
